description: Evaluates agent tool invocation correctness, prompt regression testing, and reproducible benchmark reporting

tasks.name: Design deterministic evaluation harness for agent tool invocation
tasks.user_prompt: We are updating an agent system prompt. How should we set up a benchmark to empirically test whether the agent calls our new tools with valid JSON arguments without subjective manual grading?

tasks.name: Detect prompt regression against recorded baseline runs
tasks.user_prompt: An engineer shortened a prompt to save tokens. When testing against our evaluation suite, 2 edge cases failed that passed previously. How should the benchmarker report and handle this?
